# glinet_route_policy_rule (Resource)

Manage one stock GL.iNet policy routing rule. `kind` selects the UCI section type written by the firmware.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Rule type: `default` or `rule_process`.
- `name` (String) UCI rule section name.

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this rule.
- `from` (Set of String) Match values for `from_type`.
- `from_type` (String) Match source, such as `device` or `process_gid`.
- `label` (String) Rule label shown by the stock UI.
- `mark` (String) Firewall mark, such as `0x8000`.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) Tunnel identifier.
- `via` (String) Tunnel or route the rule selects.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
